name: Administer
description: Run an organization, keep its records straight, and spot staff who are incompetent or crooked.

name: Connect
description: Know useful people, make new contacts, and call in favors from individuals or organizations.

name: Convince
description: Persuade a listener that a claim is true, with harder lies meeting a higher difficulty.

name: Craft
description: Build, repair, and maintain the goods and technology of a chosen trade.

name: Exert
description: Run, swim, climb, jump, lift, throw, and otherwise push the body to its limit.

name: Heal
description: Treat wounds, disease, poison, and mental harm, and keep a dying person alive; it does not restore lost hit points by itself.

name: Know
description: Recall history, geography, natural science, zoology, and other learned facts.

name: Lead
description: Inspire followers, keep them steady under pressure, and make a group work as one.

name: Magic
description: Work or analyze magic and recall the deeds and lore of famous spellcasters; non-casters use it only as scholarship.

name: Notice
description: Catch small details, ambushes, hidden features, and anything else that rewards a keen sense.

name: Perform
description: Sing, act, dance, orate, and compose works that hold an audience.

name: Pray
description: Conduct religious rites and know the gods, taboos, symbols, and hierarchies of faith.

name: Punch
description: Fight unarmed or with natural weapons, and reliably leave a beaten foe alive.

name: Ride
description: Handle riding animals, drive carts and carriages, care for mounts, and judge horseflesh.

name: Sail
description: Handle and repair ships and small craft, navigate, read sea weather, and manage a crew.

name: Shoot
description: Use bows, crossbows, hurlants, and thrown weapons, and keep them in working order.

name: Sneak
description: Move quietly, hide, pick pockets and locks, disguise yourself, and defeat traps and security.

name: Stab
description: Fight with melee weapons and thrown weapons, and maintain or identify them.

name: Survive
description: Hunt, fish, forage, navigate, endure harsh country, and find or build shelter.

name: Trade
description: Buy and sell, appraise goods, find black-market wares, and know the law on contraband.

name: Work
description: Practise the ordinary trade named by your background, such as farming, painting, law, or herding.
